about_the_game:
Push your favorite idol to the top!

Roll and push the adorable hololive members' 'treasures' all the way to the goal in this must-play simple 3D action game for hololive fans!

How to Play

Just roll the treasures around!

Combine the same treasures to transform them into even bigger ones!

If you stop playing, it's game over! But as long as you don't give up, you can keep challenging yourself endlessly!

Collect coins along the way to power up!

Create the biggest treasure and aim for the top!

Treasure Exchange

You can swap the treasures in the game with those of other members!

Customize it to your liking and push your favorite to the top!
